rubrics.justification: Describes key blastocyst elements (thinned zona, identifiable ICM, looser TE) reasonably, but it questions the provided 3AB grading and introduces uncertain image-based downgrading without strong support.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, uterine factor, prior biochemical/ectopic history, semen parameters, and endometrial thickness well, with appropriate emphasis on uterine environment as a major modifier.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, linking embryo quality and uterine factors to prognosis; minor tension exists between calling the embryo good quality and visually less convincing than the lab grade.

Generally consistent with IVF practice: supports single embryo transfer at age 26, cautious interpretation of morphology, selective rather than routine PGT-A, and uterine cavity evaluation; a few suggestions are more practice-based than guideline-driven.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including luteal support review, early ectopic surveillance, cavity assessment, and targeted uterine workup, though some recommendations remain somewhat broad.
